mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to surplus profits that a company has received and accumulated over a period of time which is more that its accumulated losses or liabilities."
Distributable profits refer to surplus profits that a company has received and accumulated over a period of time which is more that its accumulated losses or liabilities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a positive opportunity to communicate, not an onerous obligation."
Explanations are a positive opportunity to communicate, not an onerous obligation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the benefits of membership."
Dividend is one of the benefits of membership.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the type of corporate takeover where the shareholder(s) of a private firm purchase a large majority of the shares of a public company."
A reverse takeover is the type of corporate takeover where the shareholder(s) of a private firm purchase a large majority of the shares of a public company.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the use of rules and the strict enforcement of the rules to ensure compliance."
Mandatory approach to corporate governance refers to the use of rules and the strict enforcement of the rules to ensure compliance.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is responsible for internal controls, approval of financial statements and other significant documents prior to agreement by the full board."
Audit committee of the board is responsible for internal controls, approval of financial statements and other significant documents prior to agreement by the full board.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a modified form of the white knight defence."
White squire is a modified form of the white knight defence.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is responsible for the strategic oversight of the company; they supervise the management board."
The supervisory board is responsible for the strategic oversight of the company; they supervise the management board.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most important document of a company."
The articles of association is the most important document of a company.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the means of doing business."
A registered company is one of the means of doing business.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a threat to the aims and objectives of the separate legal personality doctrine developed in Salomon's case."
The challenges of incorporation are a threat to the aims and objectives of the separate legal personality doctrine developed in Salomon's case.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an artificial person, it can enter into contracts on its own behalf, and it can sue and be sued in its own name."
An incorporated company is an artificial person, it can enter into contracts on its own behalf, and it can sue and be sued in its own name.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a person who is liable to contribute to the assets of the company on winding up, this usually include any shareholder, particularly those that have not fully paid for the shares allotted to them."

A contributory is a person who is liable to contribute to the assets of the company on winding up, this usually include any shareholder, particularly those that have not fully paid for the shares allotted to them.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most obvious and direct method through which the controlling powers of a company may be acquired by outside investors."
Direct purchase of shares is the most obvious and direct method through which the controlling powers of a company may be acquired by outside investors.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a contract entered into by the shareholders either at the time of formation of the company or any time after the company has been formed."
Shareholder agreement is a contract entered into by the shareholders either at the time of formation of the company or any time after the company has been formed.

nomination committee

tender offer

board

company constitution
